fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, IT Security, QSA (if applicable), Compliance
fields.Volume: 1 enterprise SAQ-D (or P2PE SAQ) covering 600 terminals + ecommerce

workflows.name: PCI-DSS SAQ Scope Management & Annual Self-Assessment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "IT Security maps PCI-DSS scope" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scan of "Compliance validates control evidence" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-submit of "submits to acquirer/scheme" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-471 (ensure controlled execution — Payment Cost, Fraud & Tokenization Governance (PA-80.3).)
- operational: annual scope review and segmentation validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Scope creep or missed controls trigger fines/termination; mitigated by annual scope review and segmentation validation
System Touchpoints: - PCI-DSS scope register; ASV scan platform; AOC repository

steps.activity: IT Security maps PCI-DSS scope (CDE, connected systems, people); selects appropriate SAQ (P2PE for stores with validated terminals; SAQ-D for ecommerce)
Compliance validates control evidence (network segmentation, access controls, encryption, logging); runs internal ASV vulnerability scan quarterly
Payment Ops Manager completes SAQ and Attestation of Compliance (AOC); submits to acquirer/scheme; archives for 12 months

fields.Participants: IT Security, Ecommerce, Payment Ops Manager
fields.Trigger: New system touching PAN or scope change
fields.Volume: Tokenization vault servicing ecommerce + repeat customers

workflows.name: Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) Boundary & Tokenization Vault Governance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates no PAN storage outside vault/tokenization" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Ecommerce/Payment Ops Manager ensures all integrations use tokens not" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-471 (ensure controlled execution — Payment Cost, Fraud & Tokenization Governance (PA-80.3).)
- operational: PAN-detection tooling and developer guidelines
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: PAN leakage in logs creates breach exposure; mitigated by PAN-detection tooling and developer guidelines
System Touchpoints: - Tokenization vault; CDE segmentation; logging/SIEM with PAN-detection alerting

steps.activity: IT Security maintains CDE boundary diagram; enforces network segmentation; validates no PAN storage outside vault/tokenization
IT Security governs tokenization vault (format-preserving tokens for repeat customers, vaulted card for subscription/installation services); manages key rotation
Ecommerce/Payment Ops Manager ensures all integrations use tokens not raw PAN; validates no PAN in logs/screenshots/error messages

fields.Participants: Fraud Ops Analyst, Ecommerce, LP, Payment Ops Manager
fields.Trigger: Fraud pattern detected or periodic rule tuning

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "fingerprint mismatch, address mismatch" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews manual-review queue" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "updates velocity limits and blocklists" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-471 (ensure controlled execution — Payment Cost, Fraud & Tokenization Governance (PA-80.3).)
- operational: rule tuning and manual review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraud risk**: Exceeding scheme chargeback threshold triggers monitoring program/fines; mitigated by rule tuning and manual review
System Touchpoints: - Fraud-scoring engine; manual-review queue; scheme chargeback-monitoring program

steps.activity: Fraud Ops Analyst monitors fraud signals (velocity, BIN risk, device fingerprint mismatch, address mismatch); tunes fraud-scoring rules in gateway/ecommerce
Ecommerce/LP reviews manual-review queue; approves/declines flagged orders; contacts customer for verification on borderline cases
Fraud Ops Analyst updates velocity limits and blocklists; reports fraud rate vs. target (< 0.1%) and chargeback ratio vs. scheme threshold (1% Visa/MC)

fields.Participants: IT Security, Terminal Vendor, Payment Ops Manager
fields.Trigger: Terminal provisioning or key injection cycle
fields.Volume: ~600 POS terminals across 200 stores (3/store); key injection at provisioning + periodic rotation per scheme mandates

workflows.name: Terminal Key Injection, HSM & PIN Security Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documents key-injection certificate" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "IT Security maintains Hardware Security Module" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates terminal encryption" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-471 (ensure controlled execution — Payment Cost, Fraud & Tokenization Governance (PA-80.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Compromised injection process exposes PIN; mitigated by dual-control and certified facility
System Touchpoints: - HSM; key-injection certificate repository; terminal encryption validation

steps.activity: Terminal vendor injects cryptographic keys (under dual-control) at secured facility or remotely via HSM; documents key-injection certificate
IT Security maintains Hardware Security Module (HSM) for key generation/storage; rotates keys per scheme mandates; audits access logs
Payment Ops Manager validates terminal encryption (PIN block, SRED) before deployment; archives key-injection certificates for audit

fields.Participants: Fraud Ops Analyst, Ecommerce, Payment Ops Manager

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "routes frictionless vs." (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "checkout conversion impact" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-test of "contested with ECI/CAVV evidence" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-471 (ensure controlled execution — Payment Cost, Fraud & Tokenization Governance (PA-80.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Conversion risk**: Over-aggressive 3DS challenge reduces conversion; mitigated by frictionless optimization

steps.activity: Ecommerce enforces 3DS (EMV 3DS 2.x) on CNP transactions; routes frictionless vs. challenge flow based on risk score
Fraud Ops Analyst tracks authentication success rate and frictionless ratio; balances fraud reduction vs. checkout conversion impact
Payment Ops Manager validates liability shift (issuer liability on authenticated txns); ensures chargebacks on 3DS-authenticated sales are contested with ECI/CAVV evidence

fields.Participants: Payment Ops Mgr, IT Security, IT Incident, Legal, BSP/NPC (if breach), Acquirer
fields.Trigger: Suspected breach, terminal compromise, or acquirer incident notice

workflows.name: Payment System Incident, Breach & Forensic Response

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "IT Incident contains incident" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "Payment Ops Manager coordinates PCI-PFI" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Legal manages regulatory notification and customer notification per Data" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-471 (ensure controlled execution — Payment Cost, Fraud & Tokenization Governance (PA-80.3).)
- operational: rehearsed runbook and pre-engaged PFI
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reputational/regulatory risk**: Mishandled breach triggers fines and trust loss; mitigated by rehearsed runbook and pre-engaged PFI
System Touchpoints: - Incident response runbook; forensic tooling; BSP/NPC breach notification portal
Time Estimate: - Hours to weeks depending on severity

steps.activity: IT Incident contains incident (isolate terminal/system); IT Security starts forensic capture; Payment Ops Manager notifies acquirer/scheme per agreement
Payment Ops Manager coordinates PCI-PFI (PCI Forensic Investigator) engagement if breach suspected; notifies BSP and NPC where cardholder/personal data involved
Legal manages regulatory notification and customer notification per Data Privacy Act; Payment Ops Manager executes remediation and post-incident review

steps.activity: Payment Ops Manager tracks scheme compliance programs (Visa VFMP, MC AMP, breach accountability; acquirer flow-down of BSP IT-risk rules — Cir. 808/982); maintains evidence binder

fields.Participants: Finance Analyst, Payment Ops Manager, FP&A, Marketing

workflows.name: Payment Channel Performance, Cost-to-Serve & Tender Mix Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prepares payment dashboard" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports to FP&A and Marketing" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-471 (ensure controlled execution — Payment Cost, Fraud & Tokenization Governance (PA-80.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Strategic risk**: Suboptimal tender mix inflates cost-to-serve; mitigated by data-driven migration incentives
System Touchpoints: - Payment analytics warehouse; tender-mix dashboard; FP&A planning module

steps.activity: Finance Analyst prepares payment dashboard: tender mix %, cost-per-transaction by tender, settlement timing, dispute/chargeback ratio, fraud rate
Payment Ops Manager reports to FP&A and Marketing; recommends tender-mix strategy (e-wallet incentives to reduce cash handling cost, BNPL expansion in appliances)
FP&A incorporates payment cost into financial plan; benchmarks vs. industry; presents quarterly to Executive Committee
